name: kith
description: A self-hosted AI companion for a teenager, kept at home with a grown-up in the loop.

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w server & npm run dev -w client
scripts.build: npm run build -w desk && npm run build -w egress && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w desk && npm test -w egress && npm test -w client && npm test --prefix connect
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w desk && npm run typecheck -w egress && npm run typecheck -w client
